scientific_question: Can a bounded OpenEvo SD-LoRA update trained only on Qwen-native successes from H0.1 improve fresh-task closed-loop behavior over the frozen Qwen base?
hypothesis: Replay of diverse native Qwen success trajectories will improve at least one prespecified fresh-task metric without teacher or evaluation leakage.

source_condition.source_rule: Only H0.1 qualified-positive Qwen2.5-3B episodes may enter training; no teacher, oracle, evaluation outcome, or prompt rescue.

arms.SELF-EVOLUTION: one rank-4 OpenEvo SD-LoRA adapter fit on H0.1 native-success traces

primary_metrics: SELF-EVOLUTION minus BASE paired mean task_score
SELF-EVOLUTION minus BASE paired won rate
invalid_attempt_policy: Runtime, identity, incomplete-trace, and parser/fallback failures are reported separately and excluded from scientific score denominators.
contamination_rules: H0.1 source tasks are train-only and disjoint from fresh evaluation tasks
evaluation outcomes and traces never enter the dataset
teacher and oracle data are forbidden
one bounded adapter fit; no retry or hyperparameter sweep after valid completion
this diagnostic does not consume H1.30 formal SEED tasks

decision_rule.positive_candidate: complete paired evaluation and positive aggregate paired score delta plus positive mean score on at least two task identities
decision_rule.negative: complete paired evaluation with non-positive aggregate delta or task-local improvement only
decision_rule.claim_boundary: Fresh-task pure self-evolution diagnostic only; no OpenEvo-vs-SEED superiority claim and no teacher-bootstrap claim.

reproducibility.offline_fallback: explicit receipt after online initialization failure

next_gate: CPU tests, H0.1 reconciliation hash/source gate, fresh task manifest, adapter reload receipt, and UUID-bound GPU idle gate must pass before launch.
